    resource: aws.ec2
    filters:
      - State.Name: running
      - type: value
        key: Placement.AvailabilityZone
        op: not-in
        value: [ap-south-1a, ap-south-1b, ap-south-1c]

meta.english: No resources outside ap-south-1
